name: pr-review
description: Review a Buddy pull request with `bdy pr`: read the changed files, open threads on the exact lines, verify the author's fixes on re-review and give a verdict. Use when the user asks to review, check, go through or give feedback on a pull request ("review PR #123", "sprawdź PR #123", "przejrzyj pull 132"), or to re-review it after the author's changes. Not for only showing a PR or what changed in it (use the buddy skill), creating a PR or fixing review comments (use pr-author).
